اكتشفتا (form VIII)
# اِكْتَشَفَتَا (iktašafatā) /ik.ta.ʃa.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# اُكْتُشِفَتَا (uktušifatā) /uk.tu.ʃi.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
